title: Add Shopping Cart
content: Create shopping cart component. Container: bg-white rounded-lg shadow p-6. Header: flex justify-between, title "Shopping Cart", item count. Item list: divide-y. Item row: flex gap-4, product image (w-20 h-20), name and variant, quantity selector, price, remove button. Quantity: stepper input with +/- buttons. Subtotal: flex justify-between mt-4 pt-4 border-t. Checkout button: w-full bg-blue-600 text-white py-3 rounded-lg.

variants.simple: Create shopping cart with item list, quantities, and totals.
variants.detailed: Create shopping cart component. Container: bg-white rounded-lg shadow p-6. Header: flex justify-between, title "Shopping Cart", item count. Item list: divide-y. Item row: flex gap-4, product image (w-20 h-20), name and variant, quantity selector, price, remove button. Quantity: stepper input with +/- buttons. Subtotal: flex justify-between mt-4 pt-4 border-t. Checkout button: w-full bg-blue-600 text-white py-3 rounded-lg.
variants.advanced: Create full e-commerce cart component. Layout: responsive - side drawer on desktop, full page on mobile. Header: item count, "Clear all" link. Empty state: illustration, "Cart is empty" message, "Continue shopping" button. Item card: product thumbnail, name (link to product), variant options (size, color), unit price, quantity stepper (min 1, max stock), line total, remove button, save for later link. Quantity change: debounced update, loading state, out of stock warning if exceeds available. Saved items: separate section for "Saved for later" with move to cart button. Promo code: input with Apply button, applied codes shown as removable chips, discount reflected in totals. Order summary: subtotal, discount amount, shipping estimate (or "Calculated at checkout"), tax estimate, order total. Sticky summary: on desktop, summary sticks while scrolling items. Checkout button: prominent, loading state during checkout init. Continue shopping: link back to store. Stock warnings: low stock, out of stock indicators. Recently viewed: carousel below cart. Persistence: localStorage sync, merge with server on login.
